ZXS storage and Web management daemon

Usage: zxs [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --max-retained-workspaces <MAX_RETAINED_WORKSPACES>                                                          Host retained-workspace record limit; supply all four limits or none
      --max-retained-workspaces-per-principal <MAX_RETAINED_WORKSPACES_PER_PRINCIPAL>                              Host per-principal retained-workspace record limit
      --max-retained-workspace-metadata-bytes <MAX_RETAINED_WORKSPACE_METADATA_BYTES>                              Host retained-workspace metadata byte limit
      --max-retained-workspace-metadata-bytes-per-principal <MAX_RETAINED_WORKSPACE_METADATA_BYTES_PER_PRINCIPAL>  Host per-principal retained-workspace metadata byte limit
      --scrub-interval-seconds <SCRUB_INTERVAL_SECONDS>                                                            Non-overlapping automatic scrub interval, measured after each completed attempt [default: 86400]
      --scrub-max-age-seconds <SCRUB_MAX_AGE_SECONDS>                                                              Expire full-integrity observations from scan start, not ordinary writes [default: 172800]
      --scrub-bytes-per-second <SCRUB_BYTES_PER_SECOND>                                                            Maximum background read rate; one bounded read may burst before accounting [default: 67108864]
      --root <ROOT>                                                                                                [default: ./zxs-data]
      --management-root <MANAGEMENT_ROOT>                                                                          System-disk management state; defaults to ROOT/management, never a data member
      --storage-discovery-root <STORAGE_DISCOVERY_ROOT>                                                            Discover only immediate disk directories under this service-managed parent [default: /zxs/data/disks]
      --setup-disk <SETUP_DISKS>                                                                                   Locally approved existing disk root, repeated as opaque ID=/absolute/path
      --setup-config <SETUP_CONFIGS>                                                                               Locally reviewed private configuration preset, repeated as ID=/absolute/file
      --allow-development-setup                                                                                    Test-only: allow development-mode pool setup; production also accepts managed directories
      --listen <LISTEN>                                                                                            [default: 0.0.0.0:7400]
      --external-origin <EXTERNAL_ORIGIN>                                                                          
      --trusted-proxy-ip <TRUSTED_PROXY_IPS>                                                                       Trust this exact proxy peer; it must overwrite X-Forwarded-For with one IP
      --web-dir <WEB_DIR>                                                                                          
      --max-upload-bytes <MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES>                                                                        [default: 1073741824]
      --http-spool-bytes-per-account <HTTP_SPOOL_BYTES_PER_ACCOUNT>                                                HTTP spool quota only, including retained generations and metadata allowance [default: 107374182400]
      --http-spool-bytes-total <HTTP_SPOOL_BYTES_TOTAL>                                                            [default: 536870912000]
      --http-spool-recovery-reserve-bytes <HTTP_SPOOL_RECOVERY_RESERVE_BYTES>                                      Keep this filesystem headroom outside new upload reservations [default: 1073741824]
      --http-transfer-slots <HTTP_TRANSFER_SLOTS>                                                                  Independent capacity for each HTTP upload/read pool [default: 2]
      --http-transfer-idle-seconds <HTTP_TRANSFER_IDLE_SECONDS>                                                    [default: 60]
      --http-transfer-total-seconds <HTTP_TRANSFER_TOTAL_SECONDS>                                                  [default: 3600]
      --smb-socket <SMB_SOCKET>                                                                                    
      --smb-peer-uid <SMB_PEER_UID>                                                                                
      --smb-user <SMB_USER>                                                                                        Initial authenticated Samba account; saved selection takes precedence on restart
      --smb-allowed-user <SMB_ALLOWED_USERS>                                                                       Additional existing Samba accounts provisioned in passdb and every share valid users
      --smb-spool-bytes-per-account <SMB_SPOOL_BYTES_PER_ACCOUNT>                                                  SMB admitted private-copy extents, including retained disconnected descriptors [default: 107374182400]
      --smb-spool-bytes-total <SMB_SPOOL_BYTES_TOTAL>                                                              [default: 536870912000]
      --smb-spool-recovery-reserve-bytes <SMB_SPOOL_RECOVERY_RESERVE_BYTES>                                        [default: 1073741824]
  -h, --help                                                                                                       Print help
  -V, --version                                                                                                    Print version

The current daemon requires an existing root-owned /zxs maintenance root and holds its exclusive OS lease until all runtime workers exit. Prepare the root with zxs-helper host preview/prepare. The root is not proof of completed system initialization. Before any listener or automatic directory creation, normal startup requires existing private SYSTEM/management directories, storage configuration and completed initial activation; finish first preparation with the independent zxs-helper. Existing storage/authentication faults remain faults, never a fresh account setup. Stop older or nonparticipating writers separately; no service manager is invoked.

stdout:
Offline auxiliary tool; stop ZXS before use

Usage: zxs-helper [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  serve                 Manually serve the independent maintenance console; no login or autostart
  install               Inspect or install the matching embedded ZXS/VFS bytes; no implicit service setup
  initialization        Prepare a nonlogin service account, private layout and runtime directories
  host                  Prepare the root-owned host lease directory only, not accounts or storage
  deployment            Prepare/install fixed files or explicitly activate verified installed ZXS services
  authority             Explicit independent disk journal, separate from online pools. Stop all writers first
  configuration         Prepare or safely edit uninitialized topology drafts; never mutates a live pool
  restore-system        
  recovery-preview      
  recovery-commit       
  package               Export, verify or restore a complete independently validated history package
  scrub                 Scan retained publication metadata and required full copies; stop ZXS first
  workspace-inventory   Stream provisional physical workspace manifests, even when engine quotas are exhausted
  offline-check         
  disk-databases        Inspect current/history SQLite with explicit disk identity; never restores authority
  object-database       Inspect, export, reconstruct or verify isolated file/directory SQLite material
  disk-database-rescue  Export, rebuild or verify standalone disk SQLite rescue material; no active installation
  offline-export        
  help                  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --max-retained-workspaces <MAX_RETAINED_WORKSPACES>                                                          Host retained-workspace record limit; supply all four limits or none
      --max-retained-workspaces-per-principal <MAX_RETAINED_WORKSPACES_PER_PRINCIPAL>                              Host per-principal retained-workspace record limit
      --max-retained-workspace-metadata-bytes <MAX_RETAINED_WORKSPACE_METADATA_BYTES>                              Host retained-workspace metadata byte limit
      --max-retained-workspace-metadata-bytes-per-principal <MAX_RETAINED_WORKSPACE_METADATA_BYTES_PER_PRINCIPAL>  Host per-principal retained-workspace metadata byte limit
      --root <ROOT>                                                                                                [default: ./zxs-data]
      --principal <PRINCIPAL>                                                                                      [default: admin]
  -h, --help                                                                                                       Print help
  -V, --version                                                                                                    Print version

restore-system requires a majority of the configured original metadata members (one for a single-disk pool).
Recovery preview/commit only accepts decided, unpublished operations with all original disks accessible. It requires a reviewed digest and explicit permanent-loss acknowledgement; it is not a reset or missing-disk replacement.
Offline export validates one published version, not the entire pool or current permissions.
Disk-databases reads selected local SQLite inventories without SYSTEM; local consistency is not publication authority or content health.
Object-database exports object-local metadata and reconstructs standalone rescue SQLite from that archive; it never installs an active database or grants authority.
With no command, start the root-only, unauthenticated maintenance Web console on 0.0.0.0:9040. Use a trusted isolated network and exit after use.
The matching release helper can install its embedded ZXS executable at /usr/local/bin/zxs and explicitly install its sealed same-source VFS at the fixed Debian Samba path, without overwriting different bytes or starting services.
Engine recovery commands require the current-daemon /zxs lifetime lease; host preview/prepare can create that root without initializing the system.
A missing nonlogin Unix service account and same-name primary group can be explicitly prepared through the fixed systemd-sysusers program. Existing accounts are never modified. A selected non-root local account can receive an empty private data layout; this creates no administrator, database or disk.
Systemd/Samba configuration can be prepared as an inactive bundle or installed at fixed paths without overwriting different files, reloading, starting or enabling services.
The independent Web console can create the first management-only administrator in the exact new empty private layout; no storage is initialized.
The independent Web console can reset an existing ZXS administrator password with exact confirmation; it revokes ZXS sessions but does not update disaster-recovery credential replicas or Samba passwords.
The Web console can initialize the exact first production batch of existing empty primary roots through a non-root worker; it neither mounts/formats devices nor starts a service.
The independent Web console can add and initialize an exact empty directory batch in an existing production pool, retaining original membership intents and native receipts; this is not foreign import or an independent-authority migration.
The independent Web console can copy an exact foreign level 2/3 source into all explicitly selected lower roots as one recoverable material batch; it does not admit the source or any lower member.
The Web console can explicitly enroll a missing local tdbsam Samba account for an existing independent non-root Unix user, including native creation of a missing passdb in its existing private directory. Existing-account password resets remain separate; Separate Samba Unix account and OS dependency installation and other backends are not implemented. VFS installation is a separate exact offline-payload confirmation, not package installation or SMB login validation.
The independent Web console can explicitly deregister an exact non-final-voter member with original D3/receipt checks; disk bytes remain, but current pool visibility/content access may be lost.
Complete installation readiness/all-path clean-start gating, final-voter terminal removal and foreign admission remain incomplete. Explicit activation starts only verified installed service units; it does not install dependencies or attest network SMB/file I/O. No planned-offline action is offered.
